answer: Give every key a secret private quirk each epoch, sent only to it: grade before mining, stay idle for one random hour, open its answer with a question. An independent agent simply obeys its own note. A farm steering many keys from one shared script tends to drop the quirks or let one key's note leak into a sibling's behavior. Each slip is a small signal; once enough of them line up along one thread, the link sets like cooled basalt and those keys share a single reward slot.
